comment: Prof. Beanland is great at leading workshops but the helpfulness of her feedback depends on your style of writing. On top of working on your manuscript, she requires you to keep a journal (3 entries/ week) about your writing process which tends to feel like busy work. Heavily values participation. Heavy workload but that's expected from a 400 level

Overall, I believe she's nice, and you do need to read to be able to write, BUT, the amount of reading she gave was a bit absurd. She also is not the best teacher if you want to write fantasy or sci fi. I had an idea for a fantasy novel and she couldn't seem to understand that it wasn't historical fiction and was not helpful. I learned more online.
